text: The Tameeni insurance-comparison platform is operated by Tameeni Electronic Insurance Brokerage Ltd., a wholly-owned subsidiary of Rasan Information Technology Co., listed on the Saudi Exchange (TASI).
short: Tameeni is a wholly-owned subsidiary of listed Rasan Information Technology (TASI: 8313).
